source: Official public 2026-04-09 build, temporary analysis only; independent project implementation, no original code or art imported.

rules.moving_fire: In ordinary move, attack move and pursuit, when cooldown ready retain a living target within base attack range; otherwise choose nearest living enemy within base range. Set attack animation/cooldown without stopping movement or changing heading.
rules.pursuit: Keep pursuing inside ranged attack range, without ordinary ranged approach slowdown; dead pursuit target clears state.
rules.idle: Six-slot aggro acquisition can trigger animation/cooldown without a cooldown guard or leaving idle; this unusual legacy behavior is retained.
rules.hold: Uses stationary hold acquisition/attack; braking remains active.
rules.release: The .25 value is remaining normalized attack time: release after .8*(1-.25)=.60 seconds, matching the shared attack-timing implementation.

entry: Main menu -> legion battle -> cavalry loadout -> horse archers -> deploy; eight visible actors per regiment, independent stats/art; ordinary cavalry and default enemies unchanged.
art: Own Blender source extended with bow/quiver and existing horse, 64x64 cells, eight directions, idle/eight walk/eight action columns; moving shooting combines action upper body with distance-driven horse gait.
known_differences_or_unverified: Public legacy build only, not latest Steam equivalence.
Original browser experiment has active enemy pursuit; local isolated fixture disables enemy attacks, so no damage/time equivalence is inferred.
Original overview footage does not clearly resolve arrow releases; moving fire verification comes from source analysis and local runtime instrumentation.
Independent random stream, project projection/navigation and 64x64 sprites, not original procedural joints.
